hotels.title: Stylish Melbourne Kew Stay in One of the City’s Leafiest Enclaves
hotels.description: Set in leafy Kew, this polished Melbourne address places you moments from the Yarra River trails, the boutiques and cafés of Kew Junction, and the stately grounds of Studley Park. Spacious apartment-style accommodation brings a refined residential feel, with kitchen facilities and separate living areas suited to longer city stays. Tram links nearby connect easily to the CBD, Richmond’s dining scene and the Melbourne Cricket Ground, while nearby Victoria Gardens Shopping Centre adds cinemas, retail and casual eateries. For local dining, head to Mister Bianco for contemporary Italian or stroll to Xavier College’s surrounds and the tranquil banks of the Yarra
